entities.name: MD-to-ACC projection
aliases: mediodorsal thalamus to anterior cingulate cortex projection

relationships.subject: chronic constriction injury
relationships.evidence_quote: 7 days of chronic constriction injury (CCI; achieved by loose ligation of the sciatic nerve) generated AMPA receptor (AMPAR)-silent glutamatergic synapses within the contralateral MD-to-ACC projection

relationships.subject: GluN2B
relationships.evidence_quote: viral-mediated knockdown of GluN2B in ACC neurons, which prevented pain-induced generation of silent synapses

relationships.subject: GluN2B
relationships.evidence_quote: viral-mediated knockdown of GluN2B in ACC neurons, which prevented pain-induced generation of silent synapses and silent synapse-mediated strengthening of MD-to-ACC projection after prolonged CCI, prevented the development of allodynia

key_findings: CCI generates GluN2B-enriched AMPAR-silent synapses in the MD-to-ACC projection, which later mature to strengthen AMPAR transmission.
Knockdown of GluN2B in ACC neurons prevents silent synapse generation and the development of allodynia.
